criteria: Cover a region that can be tiled by whole unit squares, checking that the squares fill it without gaps or overlaps.
Count the squares and explain why that count gives the region's area in the chosen square unit.
Measure or interpret tiled regions using square centimeters, square meters, square inches, square feet and improvised square units.
Reject a square count as an area measurement when square sizes are mixed or the covering has gaps or overlaps.
set.description: Measure a plane region by covering it with equal unit squares without gaps or overlaps. Interpret the count as area in square units, using standard or chosen square units.
set.name: Measuring area with unit squares

set.reason: Lengths, sums and midpoints here are properties of segments with endpoints rather than of rays or whole lines.
set.scope: comparison, sums and midpoints of segments

set.reason: The perimeter formulas use rectangle opposite-side equality and square side equality to combine their boundary lengths.
set.scope: using perimeter formulas

set.reason: Two-digit columns support larger numerical areas. Repeated unit-square counts or decomposed multiplication can also compute an area, so no fixed dimension range is imposed by this preparation link.
set.scope: computing areas with two-digit side lengths

set.reason: The tiled-region interpretation explains what length times width counts. The Geometric Measurement Progression develops that interpretation before treating multiplication as a formula; knowing the formula alone does not certify the tiling procedure.
set.scope: Understanding rectangle and square area formulas as counts of square units

set.reason: The rectangle/square area formulas count equal square units, so the meaning of area and its uniform unit are part of the asserted result.
set.scope: interpreting length times width as unit-square count

set.reason: The criterion expressly permits rectangle partitions as an alternative to triangle partitions. Retain each route conditionally rather than conjoin the area formulas for every figure. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: Calculating rectangular pieces in a rectangular partition of a composite area
